description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, front entrance porch extension and erection of a detached outbuilding in the rear end of the garden for use as a gym/office to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (FL52 HH Drawing Set 29.04.22 (FL52-01-B; FL52-02-B; FL52-03-B; FL52-04-B; FL52-05-B; FL52-06-B; FL52-07-B; FL52-08-B; FL52-09-B; FL52-10-B - received 29 April 2022)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied or used at any time other than for purposes specified on the plans hereby approved or other uses which are incidental to the use of the dwelling known as 21 Parkfield Road, TW13 7LQ and shall not be used as living accommodation or a separate dwelling.
Condition : 6 - The new windows along the side elevations of the dwelling shall to be finished in obscure glazing, in accordance with the approved plans and permanently retained as such.
